acceptedAnswer.text: Businesses should consider implementing AI Website Optimization for AEO as soon as possible, especially if their target audience uses voice search, generative AI tools, or regularly seeks direct answers online. As search technology evolves, early adoption provides a significant competitive advantage. If your business relies on online visibility, or if you've noticed a decline in traffic from newer search methods, it's a strong indicator that AEO optimization is needed to remain discoverable and relevant to modern search behaviors.
